Executing the generated graduation proposal during Codex implementation or smoke testing
Codex or Claude mutation after Founder activation
Credentials in model context, credential disclosure, spending, deployment, public or LAN exposure, repository administration, force-push, history rewrite, or destructive data work
permitted_actions: Use the two exact isolated worktrees bound above
Reuse existing pinned dependencies without changing versions or lockfiles
Call real loopback Ollama during the final proposal smoke test
Reference OS-keyring-backed GitHub CLI authentication without reading its secret
Publish and merge only after full verification and independent exact-head review

Place graduation truth or approval authority in the Command Center
Use a fixture, mock, Codex, or Claude as the proposal model
Broaden model file access beyond bounded canonical evidence
Force-push, rewrite history, bypass branch protection, administer repositories, expose credentials, spend, deploy, or expose non-loopback ports
